# Data Source: tfe_hyok_customer_key_version

This data source can be used to retrieve a Hold Your Own Keys (HYOK) customer key version.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        new DataTfeHyokCustomerKeyVersion.DataTfeHyokCustomerKeyVersion(this, "tfe_hyok_customer_key_version1", new DataTfeHyokCustomerKeyVersionConfig {
            Id = "keyv-123"
        });
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `Id` (String) The ID of the HYOK customer key version.

### Read-Only

- `CreatedAt` (String) The timestamp when the key version was created.
- `Error` (String) Any error message associated with the HYOK customer key version.
- `KeyVersion` (String) The version number of the customer key version.
- `Status` (String) The status of the customer key version.
- `WorkspacesSecured` (Number) The number of workspaces secured by this customer key version.
